title: A way to explore Venus
summary: A NASA Langley concept video for HAVOC, a lighter-than-air vehicle that would carry two astronauts on a 30-day mission in Venus's upper atmosphere. It explains why the planet's surface is so hostile and why the clouds are more habitable.
why: HN shares it as the go-to visual for the idea of crewed blimps floating above Venus.

quote.text: There's this real cool concept about a manned blimp that was produced by NASA a few years ago.
